new_assertions.body: On complete 4x4, M,R,F are commuting idempotent rank-local reductions and every tested composition remains Q-F congruent.
On complete 4x4, R+F strictly compresses q_o from 34,094 to 31,389 literal Q-F classes.
On complete 4x4, composing S4 orbiting with R+F yields 9,676 transporter-aware Q-F classes, strictly below either operation alone.
The direct/algebraic orbit quotient and rank-local recursive/deletion channel compose without forcing the evaluator D to take either form.
M adds no observed partition reduction once R is present in complete 4x4; general absorption is a proof candidate, not yet authority.
